subject: The inla result collection failed, when verbose = FALSE

messages.author: b268dc9356ce156a
messages.subject: The inla result collection failed, when verbose = FALSE
parts:
I have recently reinstalled INLA in order to get back to an old spatial modelling project I was working on 3 years ago.

I have been testing the installation, including using the test example given at https://www.r-inla.org/download-install 

The issue I am having is that whenever I execute an inla() model, if verbose is set to FALSE (the default), the model fails with:
Error in inla.core.safe(formula = formula, family = family, contrasts = contrasts, : The inla result collection failed.

However if I set verbose to TRUE, then the model executes as expected. I have tried this with several different models and on two separate computer systems and this error consistently occurs. While not strictly a problem per se, it seems like an odd quirk of the inla() rather than e.g. problems with model specification. Test model code and session info provided below.

Best, 
Mat :)

library(INLA)
n = 100; a = 1; b = 1; tau = 100
z = rnorm(n)
eta = a + b*z
scale = exp(rnorm(n))
prec = scale*tau
y = rnorm(n, mean = eta, sd = 1/sqrt(prec))
data = list(y=y, z=z)
formula = y ~ 1+z
result = inla(formula, family = "gaussian", data = data)

Error in inla.core.safe(formula = formula, family = family, contrasts = contrasts, : The inla result collection failed. The inla result collection failed.
